commentary.text: 90+11' The match has just finished.

90+10' Bryan Gil (Tottenham) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
90+9' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.

90+7' Giovani Lo Celso tees up Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) with a precision cross. He holds off the defender, but fires his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+5' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
90+4' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joao Pedro leaves the pitch and Adam Lallana (Brighton) comes on.
90+1' Good defending. Bryan Gil (Tottenham) tries to find Heung-Min Son inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
87' Referee Jarred Gillett points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Tottenham players celebrate.
86' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Tottenham players aren’t happy.
85' 4 - 2 It's a goal! Ben Davies (Tottenham) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 4:2.
85' Tottenham take a short corner kick.
85' Tottenham play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. Tottenham will take a corner kick.
84' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jarred Gillett stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
83' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
82' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
82' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
81' 4 - 1 Goal! Heung-Min Son plays a short, square pass into the path of Alejo Veliz (Tottenham), who bends a shot straight into the bottom left corner to make it 4:1. Fabulous goal!
80' The current number of shots on goal is 9:1.
75' 4 - 0 Goal! Joao Pedro (Brighton) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Guglielmo Vicario.
75' Joao Pedro (Brighton) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
75' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
74' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul. PENALTY to Brighton! Great chance to score.
72' Joao Pedro (Brighton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jarred Gillett no option but to blow his whistle.
72' Bryan Gil (Tottenham) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jarred Gillett who sees an offensive foul.
70' The referee shows the yellow card to Jakub Moder (Brighton).
70' Substitution. Alejo Veliz (Tottenham) on for Brennan Johnson.
69' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Danny Welbeck will be replaced by Evan Ferguson (Brighton).
69' Jakub Moder (Brighton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing James Milner.
68' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) jumps into a tackle and Jarred Gillett signals a foul.
68' Brighton hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
65' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Pape Matar Sarr and he is replaced by Bryan Gil (Tottenham).
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) replaces Richarlison.

63' 3 - 0 James Milner takes the corner and the ball somehow falls to Pervis Estupinan (Brighton), who unleashes a wonderful long-range shot that goes past the goalkeeper and into the top right corner. He makes it 3:0.
63' James Milner (Brighton) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
63' Joao Pedro (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner.
62' Richarlison (Tottenham) has a goal ruled out for offside!
61' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Facundo Buonanotte departs the field of play to be replaced by Carlos Baleba (Brighton).
59' Poor challenge! Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) is penalised for tripping and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle.
57' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Richarlison (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Jason Steele.
54' Richarlison (Tottenham) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
54' Richarlison (Tottenham) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
49' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Now Brighton have a corner.
49' A dangerous looking corner kick from James Milner (Brighton) is cleared to safety by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brighton.
48' James Milner (Brighton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Brighton will have a corner.
47' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) makes a strong challenge and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
46' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Richarlison (Tottenham) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
46' Half-time substitution. Roberto De Zerbi decided to make a change. Igor (Brighton) is replaced by Pervis Estupinan.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle after Joao Pedro (Brighton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
45+4' The corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is intercepted by the defence.

45+3' Tottenham are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
45+2' Tottenham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+2' Richarlison (Tottenham) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the left post. Close!
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brighton.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.

45' Joao Pedro (Brighton) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the top of the net, but Guglielmo Vicario made a superb athletic save to deny him. Brighton earn a corner.
43' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) gets booked.
42' Joao Pedro (Brighton) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
40' Igor (Brighton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jarred Gillett saw the whole situation.
39' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
38' A goal, which was scored by Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton), was disallowed due to offside.
37' Dangerous play by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton). Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Tottenham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
35' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) passes the ball onto Joao Pedro, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
33' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
32' POST! James Milner (Brighton) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
30' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' Decent spell from Brighton here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
28' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

27' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
23' 2 - 0 Goal! Joao Pedro (Brighton) slams home the penalty with a precise low shot into the bottom left corner.
23' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is going to take the penalty!
23' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) has received a yellow card for his foul.
23' The Brighton players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
21' Referee Jarred Gillett makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Brighton. Let’s see what happens!
21' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Brighton for a penalty. Play continues.
21' CHANCE! Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the right post!
20' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brighton.
20' Joao Pedro (Brighton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
17' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Guglielmo Vicario stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
15' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

14' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Tottenham can continue in their attacking effort.
13' Jarred Gillett couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) and blew his whistle.

11' 1 - 0 Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) controls the ball with a great first touch just outside the penalty area after receiving a pass and smashes the ball into the roof of the net to give the goalkeeper no chance!
10' Some patient build-up play from Brighton as they look to unlock the defence.
6' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.

6' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the roof of the net, but it wasn't dangerous and Guglielmo Vicario gathered easily.
5' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
3' Igor (Brighton) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for an infringement.
2' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
2' Joao Pedro (Brighton) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
1' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jarred Gillett.
